title: New Password Validated Against Argon2id-Policy Strength Rules
description: The frontend module shall validate the new password against the password strength policy before enabling the submit button.
rationale: Client-side validation prevents a round-trip rejection for weak passwords; the client applies a strength policy at least as strict as the server's minimum-length floor, so a UI-approved password is always server-acceptable. Additional client-side rules are documented in passwordValidation.ts.
